llamacpp local provider routes requests via llamacpp/ model prefix with no auth

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"llamacpp/my-model\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
print(result)
```
